ActuatorLimits.description: Deterministic per-actuator limits enforced by the safety governor.

maxMagnitude.description: Hard ceiling on normalized magnitude 0..1 (device safe limit).

maxPatternSteps.description: Max steps in a pattern timeline.

maxPayloadBytes.description: Max payload size in bytes accepted by the driver.

externalSideEffect.description: True when effects leave the local machine.

human.description:
Optional human-readable layer (presentation + effect semantics).
Never a safety truth source; formal fields above always win.

parametersSchema.description: JSON Schema for driver-specific action parameters.

Availability.description: Whether a capability is currently available for planning.

oneOf.description: Registered but requires consent that has not been granted in the session.
Permission was revoked at runtime.

CapabilityConstraint.description:
A human-readable constraint the AI should surface when planning
(e.g. "quiet hours active until 08:00").

sessionBudgetMs.description: Cumulative active-duration budget per session, in ms.

ConfirmationLevel.description:
The strongest delivery level an actuator can actually confirm.
`queued` NEVER implies `completed`; UIs must not display beyond this level.

oneOf.description: One action only.

ConsentSemantics.description:
Consent guidance in human terms. The *requirement* itself stays in the
formal manifest (`requires_consent`) and the governor.

reason.description: Why consent is needed, in plain language.

CostDescriptor.description: Cost hints used by the orchestrator's utility scoring.

monetaryPerInvocation.description: Monetary cost per invocation in USD (0 for local channels).

resource.description: Abstract resource cost 0..1 (CPU, battery, attention budget).

DataRetention.description: How long observed data is retained.

DataSemantics.description:
What a receptor's data means for the person: categories, whether it is
personal, whether it leaves this machine.

factFields.description: Fact keys that are direct observations.

inferenceFields.description: Fields that are model inferences (must be shown as guesses).

DataSensitivityLevel.description: Sensitivity of the data a receptor produces, in human terms.

providerAllowlist.description: Provider allowlist for delegation targets; empty = none allowed.

EffectSemantics.description: What an actuator or write-operation affects.

confirmationLevel.description: The deepest confirmation the driver can honestly provide.

HumanMeta.description: The optional human layer bundle carried by manifests.

HumanPresentation.description:
Structured human description an adapter attaches to a capability.
Purely presentational: names, examples, setup help. Never safety facts.

beginnerRecommended.description: Suggested for first-time users in onboarding.

category.description:
Presentation category (e.g. `notification`, `time`); may differ from
the technical manifest category.

iconHint.description: Icon name hint from the shared icon set (e.g. `bell`, `clock`).

InitiativeLevel.description: How proactive the runtime may be without an explicit request.

oneOf.description: Never initiate; only respond to explicit requests.
May surface low-risk, non-interrupting signals.
May initiate bounded interactions on allowed channels.

Interruptiveness.description: How disruptive an actuator's output is.

LocalizedText.description:
Localized text keyed by BCP-47 tag (`zh-TW`, `en`, …).

Lookup falls back: exact tag → same primary language → `en` → any entry.

OperationId.description: Identifies one operation of a tool, e.g. `interaction.observe`.

actuatorAllowlist.description: Explicit actuator allowlist; empty = builtin low-risk defaults only.

allowedChannels.description: Channels the runtime may use at all.

channelLimits.description: Per-channel limits keyed by channel name; `*` applies to all.

defaultTtlMs.description: Global default TTL for plans/actions, ms.

delegation.description: Deterministic delegation limits for agent sessions.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, only read-only operations are allowed.

maxPatternSteps.description: Hard cap for any pattern's steps.

maxScheduledActions.description: Hard cap on total scheduled (queued+running) actions.

receptorAllowlist.description: Explicit receptor allowlist; empty = builtin defaults only.

requireApprovalAt.description: Actions at or above this risk require explicit human approval.

resumeHighRiskAfterRestart.description:
Whether high-risk physical output may resume automatically after crash.
This is deliberately not configurable to `true` via the public API.

sessionMonetaryBudget.description: Monetary budget per session in USD.

toolAllowlist.description: Tool operations that may be invoked.

QuietHours.description: A daily quiet window in local wall-clock time ("HH:MM" 24h).

silencedChannels.description: Channels silenced during the window; empty = all audible/intrusive ones.

ReceptorId.description: Identifies a receptor instance, e.g. `system.time` or `mock.receptor`.

human.description:
Optional human-readable layer (presentation + data semantics).
Never a safety truth source; formal fields above always win.

provides.description: Fact keys this receptor can provide, e.g. `["event", "state"]`.

RiskClass.description:
Risk classification of an operation / actuator.

Ordering matters: later variants are riskier. `Ord` is derived so policy can
compare against thresholds.

oneOf.description: Pure read, no side effect.
Local, reversible, low-noise side effect (log line, UI hint).
Side effect bounded by deterministic policy limits (sound, haptic, notification).
Writes that leave the machine (webhook, message, GitHub comment).
Hard-to-reverse or high-impact operations (merge PR, purchase, physical device).
Destructive / safety-critical. Always requires explicit human approval.

Sensitivity.description: How sensitive the data produced by a receptor is.

oneOf.description: Non-personal machine state (system time, task lifecycle).
Workspace-level information (file names, task titles).
Personal but not biometric (user text, presence).
Camera, microphone, location, physiological signals.

human.description: Optional human-readable layer. Never a safety truth source.

ToolRole.description: Role a tool operation plays in the interaction loop.

sessionPolicy.description: Policy view relevant to planning (limits, initiative, quiet hours).

version.description: Monotonic-ish version: changes whenever registry content changes.

post.summary: Discover the current receptors, actuators, tool operations, constraints and session policy. Always call before planning; never assume a device exists.
